action_items: Backend suite had no tests to run; this is expected because all acceptance criteria are content-driven/UI-only and no API-bearing criterion was provided.

checks.criterion: Portfolio renders as a modern responsive one-page experience with a light white-and-black editorial theme
checks.name: portfolio-renders-editorial
checks.evidence: Local browser check passed at desktop 1280x720 and mobile 390x844; portfolio-page, ADNAN.PAL logo, hero-heading, and mobile navigation toggle were visible.

checks.criterion: Primary navigation reaches the requested sections
checks.name: portfolio-navigation-sections
checks.evidence: Local browser check clicked About, Skills, Deployments, Projects, and Contact anchors and verified matching sections; opened mobile navigation and clicked mobile About.

checks.criterion: Theme toggle works without breaking the page
checks.name: portfolio-theme-toggle
checks.evidence: Local browser check verified html dark class after toggle, hero remained visible, and html returned to light state after second toggle.

checks.criterion: Deployment section covers AWS, Vercel, and Render
checks.name: portfolio-deployment-tabs
checks.evidence: Local browser check verified AWS panel, selected Vercel and Render tabs, and verified each panel name plus services/description/log surfaces.

checks.criterion: Project showcase preserves all six projects with animated card presentation
checks.name: portfolio-project-showcase
checks.evidence: Local browser check verified visible cards for Arcane, BuildNet, Trading Website, AI Website Builder, Notes Manager, and Data Structure Visualizer plus representative code, live demo, and ask links.

checks.criterion: Contact area provides presentation-only contact actions
checks.name: portfolio-contact-actions
checks.evidence: Local browser check verified email, LinkedIn, GitHub, Hire Me mailto href, and Copy email changed to Copied with clipboard permission granted.

checks.criterion: LeetCode section preserves the displayed profile stats
checks.name: portfolio-leetcode-stats
checks.evidence: Public preview browser check passed at https://portfolio-refresh-185.preview.emergentagent.com; verified total 62, Easy 28, Medium 31, Hard 3, and profile href.
